agentContributions.notes: Fixed site confirmed in src/fares.ts::fareFor line 10: uses > (strict greater-than) instead of >= (greater-than-or-equal), excluding age 65 from concession fare eligibility. Comment on line 7 correctly states 'Riders aged 65 AND OVER', confirming this is a boundary bug. The change to >= aligns the code with the specification.

Kept openspec's AC1 and AC2—solid boundary tests for the age 65 threshold. Decomposed openspec's vague AC3 into four specific, testable criteria: AC3 tests the boundary immediately above 65 (age 66) to confirm the fix doesn't break existing senior fare logic; AC4 tests child concessions (age 12 < 13) to ensure child fares are unchanged; AC5 tests regular adult fares (age 30 in the 18–64 range) to ensure base fare logic is unchanged; AC6 tests pass-holder logic (age 65 with pass) to ensure fare exemption persists regardless of the age boundary fix. Together these provide comprehensive regression coverage while remaining observable and testable.
